title: Moon in Ashwini
text: Ashwini, ruled by Ketu and the Ashwini Kumaras (celestial healers), gives a pioneering, energetic and quick-acting nature. The native heals, initiates and moves fast, loves independence and travel, but can be impulsive and impatient.

title: Moon in Bharani
text: Bharani, ruled by Venus and the deity Yama, gives strong will, endurance and a capacity to bear burdens and transform. The native is determined and creative, with powerful desires that benefit from discipline.

title: Moon in Krittika
text: Krittika, ruled by the Sun and the fire-deity Agni, gives sharpness, courage and a cutting, purifying intellect. The native is ambitious and protective, with a fiery drive to achieve and a taste for recognition.

title: Moon in Rohini
text: Rohini, ruled by the Moon and the deity Brahma, is counted among the most favourable birth stars. It gives charm, beauty, artistic talent, material prosperity and a magnetic, sensual nature, though attachment to comfort is a theme.

title: Moon in Mrigashira
text: Mrigashira, ruled by Mars and the deity Soma, gives a curious, searching and gentle nature. The native is a seeker — of knowledge, experience or the ideal — often restless, communicative and fond of exploration.

title: Moon in Ardra
text: Ardra, ruled by Rahu and the storm-deity Rudra, gives intensity, intellectual depth and the power to break down and rebuild. The native can be emotionally turbulent but transformative, probing and determined to get to the truth.

title: Moon in Punarvasu
text: Punarvasu, ruled by Jupiter and the deity Aditi, gives optimism, resilience and the ability to renew and recover. The native is philosophical, generous and adaptable, finding safety and return after every setback.

title: Moon in Pushya
text: Pushya, ruled by Saturn and the priest-deity Brihaspati, is regarded as the most nourishing and auspicious nakshatra. It gives caring, dutiful and spiritually inclined qualities, stability, and the ability to support and provide for others.

title: Moon in Ashlesha
text: Ashlesha, ruled by Mercury and the Nagas (serpent deities), gives penetrating insight, strategic intelligence and hypnotic charm. The native is perceptive and persuasive, with a gift for understanding hidden motives; detachment guards against possessiveness.

title: Moon in Magha
text: Magha, ruled by Ketu and the Pitris (ancestors), gives dignity, pride in heritage and a regal, authoritative bearing. The native honours tradition and lineage, seeks respect and position, and carries a sense of noble responsibility.

title: Moon in Purva Phalguni
text: Purva Phalguni, ruled by Venus and the deity Bhaga, gives warmth, creativity and a love of pleasure, leisure and the arts. The native is generous, sociable and romantic, enjoying life's comforts and bringing joy to others.

title: Moon in Uttara Phalguni
text: Uttara Phalguni, ruled by the Sun and the deity Aryaman, gives generosity, reliability and a talent for friendship, partnership and service. The native balances kindness with ambition and is valued for loyalty and helpfulness.

title: Moon in Hasta
text: Hasta, ruled by the Moon and the Sun-deity Savitar, gives skill with the hands, cleverness and resourcefulness. The native is industrious, dexterous and witty, able to craft and manifest, though attention to detail can tip into worry.

title: Moon in Chitra
text: Chitra, ruled by Mars and the celestial architect Vishwakarma, gives an eye for design, beauty and craftsmanship. The native is charismatic and creative, drawn to building things of lasting brilliance and to a striking personal style.

title: Moon in Swati
text: Swati, ruled by Rahu and the wind-deity Vayu, gives independence, adaptability and a love of freedom. The native is self-reliant, diplomatic and flexible, flourishing through trade, movement and the ability to go their own way.

title: Moon in Vishakha
text: Vishakha, ruled by Jupiter and the deities Indra and Agni, gives ambition, determination and goal-focused drive. The native pursues aims single-mindedly and achieves through persistence, balancing desire with purpose.

title: Moon in Anuradha
text: Anuradha, ruled by Saturn and the friendship-deity Mitra, gives devotion, loyalty and a talent for cooperation and lasting bonds. The native succeeds through friendship and organised group effort, often far from home, with steady emotional depth.

title: Moon in Jyeshtha
text: Jyeshtha, ruled by Mercury and the king-deity Indra, gives seniority, responsibility and protective authority. The native is capable and commanding, often carrying heavy duties, and benefits from humility amid their drive for status.

title: Moon in Mula
text: Mula, ruled by Ketu and the destruction-deity Nirriti, gives a probing, truth-seeking nature that gets to the root of things. The native is philosophical and investigative, often experiencing upheaval that ultimately frees them toward deeper understanding.

title: Moon in Purva Ashadha
text: Purva Ashadha, ruled by Venus and the water-deity Apas, gives conviction, ambition and invincible optimism. The native is persuasive and proud, with a rejuvenating influence on others and a drive toward recognition and improvement.

title: Moon in Uttara Ashadha
text: Uttara Ashadha, ruled by the Sun and the Vishwadevas (universal gods), gives integrity, leadership and lasting achievement. The native succeeds through righteous effort and perseverance, earning enduring respect rather than quick wins.

title: Moon in Shravana
text: Shravana, ruled by the Moon and the preserver Vishnu, gives a gift for listening, learning and connection. The native gathers knowledge and wisdom, is a good counsellor and communicator, and often rises through scholarship or reputation.

title: Moon in Dhanishta
text: Dhanishta, ruled by Mars and the eight Vasus, gives rhythm, wealth-building ability and musical or performative talent. The native is energetic, prosperous and generous, thriving in group endeavours and public life.

title: Moon in Shatabhisha
text: Shatabhisha, ruled by Rahu and the cosmic-waters deity Varuna, gives a healing, secretive and independent nature. The native is drawn to mysteries, medicine and technology, often unconventional and private, with a gift for solving hidden problems.

title: Moon in Purva Bhadrapada
text: Purva Bhadrapada, ruled by Jupiter and the fierce fire-deity Aja Ekapada, gives intensity, idealism and a willingness to sacrifice for a cause. The native is passionate and visionary, drawn to profound or spiritual pursuits, sometimes unconventional.

title: Moon in Uttara Bhadrapada
text: Uttara Bhadrapada, ruled by Saturn and the deep-sea serpent Ahir Budhnya, gives wisdom, depth and a calm, compassionate temperament. The native is patient and self-controlled, with strong spiritual grounding and the ability to bring peace amid turmoil.

title: Moon in Revati
text: Revati, ruled by Mercury and the deity Pushan (protector of travellers), gives gentleness, compassion and a nurturing, guiding spirit. The native is kind, artistic and spiritually inclined, a natural protector who helps others find their way.
